page.overview:
Who is Zim Zam Blattis?

Zim Zam Blattis was a male Gungan leader of a smuggling gang during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following 0 BBY, a spacer was tasked by Gavyn Sykes to eliminate Blattis, in which the spacer succeeded.
